scope: Canonical Rekordbox 7.2.19 response shapes observed by the conformance lab.

golden_corpus.selection: final .json files excluding .actual.json and files beneath attempts or failed-attempts directories
golden_corpus.hash_algorithm: sha256(relative_path + NUL + file_bytes, sorted by path)

suite_declaration_corpus.hash_algorithm: sha256(relative_path + NUL + file_bytes, sorted by path)

attribution_rule: header and raw_response messages belong to the declared request; page messages belong to the separate implicit 0x3000 render request

asynchronous_pre_request_drains.attribution: asynchronous; not assigned to the following request
